analysis.original_request: 我正在为低轨空间平台上的太阳盲紫外臭氧与高空燃烧羽流探测器设计前端滤光膜。探测器需要尽可能透过 255–280 nm 的太阳盲紫外信号，同时尽可能抑制 300–700 nm 可见光背景和 700–1100 nm 近红外杂散光。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底的条件下，设计一个不含金属层、仅使用常规可沉积无机介质材料的平面多层膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a front-end filter coating for a solar-blind UV ozone and high-altitude combustion plume detector on a low-orbit space platform. The detector requires maximum transmission of the 255–280 nm solar-blind UV signal, while suppressing the 300–700 nm visible background and 700–1100 nm near-infrared stray light. Conditions: unspecified material incidence, fused silica substrate, no metal layers, only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials, planar multilayer film, total layers not exceeding 30.
